data.$comment: The views.v1 profile's presentation document, faithful to ZenSight's views.toml v1 (zensight-common/src/views.rs) with ONE change: ViewHeader.producer becomes `interface`, and a panel may name another `interface`. In v1 a scope was a subject pattern of one producer's slice. In zk2 a service implements several interfaces, so a scope is a template prefix of a named interface major. Closed, structural, no expressions: anything conditional is a Rhai slot the GUI evaluates.

Action.description: A write operation on a row: an operation template of the panel's interface (was a v1 procedure path).

Limit.description: A sibling field name (the publisher's own limit), or a literal that admits whose it is.

interface.description: zk2 addition: the interface major this panel scopes, when not the header's.

procedure.description: reply: the read operation whose response renders the panel.

schema.description: document: the type name, default the resource's.

scope.description: A template prefix up to its last variable, possibly extended by literal chunks selecting a field subtree (`thermal/{sensor}`). Sibling resources under it form one row family.

Slot.description: A literal ($var binds a template variable) or a Rhai script.

group_by.description: One card per binding of this template variable, or the literal `service` for one card per device service (v1's `{device}` / `{chassis}` under device-as-service).

interface.description: The interface major whose templates the panels scope by default (was `producer`), e.g. zs.bmc.v1.
